basic_profile.bio: I'm a 21-year-old army recruit currently in AIT at Fort Gordon, training as a 25B (Information Technology Specialist). Originally from Oklahoma, I joined Reddit to connect with others in the military and to find advice on navigating army life. In my downtime, I enjoy gaming, especially strategy and FPS games, and I'm keen on learning more about technology. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after training. I'm currently single and focused on my career in the army.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is primarily centered around military training and the IT field, both acquired through my current role as a 25B in the army. While I'm still learning the ropes, I've been actively seeking advice from more experienced individuals in my unit and online to better understand my MOS.
